description: This file defines the NmapOutputProcessor class, a specific implementation for processing and parsing the XML output of the Nmap network scanning tool. It converts the XML data into asset models, identifying hosts and open ports, and returns a ProcessorResult containing these assets.

classes.name: NmapOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class extending AbstractOutputProcessor that processes XML output from Nmap scans to extract host and port information, converting it into internal asset models.

methods.name: getCommandUsageExample
methods.description: Returns an example command line for using nmap that produces parseable XML output.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads an XML file at the given path, parses host and port information, and wraps it into a ProcessorResult object with associated assets.
